fields.name: value
fields.documentation: A typed concentration value. Statement leaves that observe, assert or impose a concentration inherit this `value`. Series-as-cardinality (Brainstorm I): an ARRAY of the composite; a single reading is the length-1 case. Per-sample timing is a time covariate along a time dimension: in the statement's `dimensions` and `covariates` when inline, on each body's when stored in a body (#73 item 21; keys until 2026-10-22, data_body plan AMENDMENT 6).

fields.name: molar
fields.documentation: Canonical concentration value (OPTIONAL -- filled when the source unit is computable into it; concentration has no single canonical). Absent only when `base.needs_info` names it (the source gave no unit, or a unit with no conversion; `source_value` and `source_unit` keep what the source wrote) -- Jess Haley 2026-10-30 [canonical absent only as needs info].

fields.name: optical_density
fields.documentation: Canonical optical density (absorbance, dimensionless; OPTIONAL). The wavelength (600 nm for OD600) is a condition of the statement, or is said by the source unit "OD600" (`source_unit`); `od600` until 2026-10-22, Jess Haley [ratio slots named by unit]. Absent only when `base.needs_info` names it (the source gave no unit, or a unit with no conversion; `source_value` and `source_unit` keep what the source wrote) -- Jess Haley 2026-10-30 [canonical absent only as needs info].

fields.name: source_unit
fields.documentation: The unit the source gave the value in, as a term: the unit's registered term (schemas/registry/did_v2_term_registry.json), its label as the name (V_eta_source_unit_plan.md). Blank when the source gives no unit.

fields.name: source_value
fields.documentation: The number as given by the source, in `source_unit`.

fields.name: approximate
fields.documentation: True when the value is approximate.

fields.name: tolerance
fields.documentation: The bound on this value: the true value lies between `value - minus` and `value + plus`, in the unit of the canonical slot that is filled. Asymmetric when the uncertainty is one-sided (a clock time written to the minute is minus 0 / plus 59 s). ABSENT means no tolerance is stated. A bound, not a standard deviation (CHANGE 7).

fields.name: minus
fields.documentation: How far BELOW the stated value the true value may lie, in the unit of the canonical slot that is filled (for a time: how much EARLIER). Non-negative.

fields.name: plus
fields.documentation: How far ABOVE the stated value the true value may lie, in the unit of the canonical slot that is filled (for a time: how much LATER). Non-negative.
